response.original_title: [Dispute-Guide] How to Dispute a Charge with American Cruise Lines?
response.overview: To dispute a charge with American Cruise Lines 1-866-254-7549, you should first attempt to resolve the issue directly with the cruise line 1-866-254-7549. If direct communication fails, you can then escalate the matter by filing a chargeback with your credit card issuer. Contact American Cruise Lines Directly The fastest way to fix an error like duplicate billing or an incorrect charge is to contact their specialized billing and guest experience teams. By Phone: Call customer service at 1-866-254-7549. State your case clearly and 1-866-254-7549 ask to speak with the payments or billing department. If the front-line agent cannot resolve the problem 1-866-254-7549, firmly but politely request a supervisor review. By Email: Send a detailed explanation along with your attachments to Inquiry@AmericanCruiseLines.com. For formal cruise cancellations or delay-related refunds, you can submit claims to Reservations@AmericanCruiseLines.com
